text: Which component typically represents a single screen with UI?
explanation: An Activity represents an interactive screen.

subject: Android Programming
text: Which callback is called when an activity becomes visible?
explanation: onStart is called as the activity becomes visible.

subject: Android Programming
text: Which object is used to request an action from another Android component?
explanation: An Intent describes an action and carries data between components.

subject: Android Programming
text: Where are Android app components and permissions declared?
explanation: The manifest declares app components and permissions.

text: Which layout arranges children in a single row or column?
explanation: LinearLayout arranges children horizontally or vertically.
